capabilities: Ask Yes/No and How Much? oracles with configurable probability and card or dice randomization
Generate plot hooks, NPCs, plot twists, flavor and random events from tables
Run scene complications and PbtA-inspired Beat and Failure GM moves
Track dungeon rooms and hexcrawl exploration with persistent state across sessions
Log, filter, pin and export session rolls as Markdown or JSON
extras: Independent implementation of a CC-BY-SA 4.0 engine; README states it is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author. Bilingual UI (English and Spanish). Manual installation or via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for playing solo TTRPGs, so oracle rolls, content generation and dungeon or hexcrawl tracking must be done outside the vault or by hand.

relations.evidence: This plugin implements the mechanics of One Page Solo Engine v1.6, created by Karl Hendricks

summary: Solo roleplaying toolkit that implements the One Page Solo Engine v1.6 oracles, generators, scene engine and dungeon/hex trackers inside Obsidian.
